Name: Quadricep
Definition: The greater extensor muscle of the front of the thigh that is divided into four parts

Name: Bicep
Definition: The large flexor muscle of the front of the upper arm

Name: Hamstring
Definition: Any of three muscles at the back of the thigh that function to flex and rotate the leg and extend the thigh

Name: Triceps
Definition: The large muscle at the back of the arm

Name: Gastrocnemius
Definition: The outer calf muscle that goes from the back of the knee to the heel

Name: Deltoid
Definition: A large triangular muscle that covers the shoulder joint and serves to raise the arm laterally

Name: Gluteus
Definition: Any of the large muscles of the buttocks

Name: Mastoid
Definition: A muscle in the head that helps move the head

Name: Trapezius
Definition: A large muscle between the head and neck

Name: Pectorals
Definition: Either of two large muscles in the chest that help move the shoulder and upper arm

Name: Intercostals
Definition: Any of the short muscles that extend between the ribs filling in most of the intervals between them and serving to move the ribs in respiration

Name: Rectus Abdominus
Definition: A pair of muscles located along the midline of the abdominal region

Name: Latissimus Dorsi
Definition: A broad flat superficial muscle chiefly of the middle and lower back that extends, adducts, and rotates the arm medially

Name: Femur
Definition: The proximal bone of the hind or lower limb that extends from the hip to the knee

Name: Tibia
Definition: The inner and usually larger of the two bones of the lower limb between the knee and ankle

Name: Fibula
Definition: The outer and usually smaller of the two bones between the knee and ankle

Name: Tarsals
Definition: A tarsal part (such as a bone or cartilage)

Name: Metatarsals
Definition: Five elongated bones which form the front of the instep and ball of the foot

Name: Phalanges
Definition: One of the digital bones of the hand or foot of a vertebrate

Name: Patella
Definition: A thick flat triangular movable bone that forms the anterior point of the knee

Name: Humerus
Definition: The long bone of the upper arm extending from the shoulder to the elbow

Name: Radius
Definition: The bone on the thumb side of the human forearm

Name: Ulna
Definition: The bone on the little-finger side of the human forearm

Name: Carpals
Definition: The bones of the wrist

Name: Metacarpals
Definition: The bones of the hand between the carpus and the phalanges

Name: Cranium
Definition: The part of the skull that encloses the brain

Name: Ribcage
Definition: The bony enclosing wall of the chest consisting of the ribs and connecting structures

Name: Sternum
Definition: The flat bone that articulates with the clavicles and the first seven pairs of ribs

Name: Scapula
Definition: Pair of large triangular bones forming the principal bone of the shoulder girdle

Name: Ilium
Definition: The broad, upper, and largest of the three principal bones of the pelvis

Name: Vertebra
Definition: One of the bony segments composing the spinal column

Name: Ischium
Definition: The lower and posterior of the three principal bones of the pelvis
